query_allowlist.redaction: only predeclared RA-004 prerequisite and target object names

query_allowlist.expected_result: only approved prerequisite and RA-004 signatures with expected owners and properties

query_allowlist.purpose: verify exact role attributes and membership edges

query_allowlist.purpose: verify RA-004 ownership, ACL and RLS boundaries

query_allowlist.purpose: attest the private evidence destination before any database connection
